brand.legal_note: Prim is the product noun and category. Eidos AGI is the company; this pack is the Prim product surface, not the company house kit. Do not mint prims.brand.
brand.positioning: A file that stores information, and tools that interact with it.
brand.tagline: The source of truth. Everything else is a view.
brand.category_line: The primitive unit of knowledge and memory for AI.

nouns.use: Singular pack. The file. Everyday speech stays on Prim.
nouns.dont: Do not say 'a Prims' for one file. Profile names belong in specs.

nouns.use: The family of tools around the file. Display name of this pack.
nouns.dont: Do not use Prims as the singular file noun.

nouns.use: Personal Mac memory pack. Live face is prims.sh/desktop.
nouns.dont: Never desktop.prims.sh. Do not call it Prim Desktop or the Desktop connector.

nouns.use: Company house. Use packs/eidos. Under the hood, Prims are additive profiles from Eidos.
nouns.dont: Do not put the Eidos tridot or brass/cream house doctrine on a Prim surface.

nouns.use: One pairing. Surface talks to a person. Connector talks to a system. Tools cite a type; they are not types.
nouns.dont: If it is not surface or connector, it is a script. Do not mint a third tool kind.

nouns.use: A surface. One of three Desktop doors (Viewer, Connectors, Chat). Hosted on prims.sh/viewers.
nouns.dont: Viewer is not a Desktop connector.

nouns.use: Talks to a system. Ops secondary. Still behind approve.
nouns.dont: Do not hide a viewer inside Connectors.

nouns.use: ACP harness under the hood. Chat steers the open Prim. Drivers stay hidden in chrome.
nouns.dont: Do not brand the harness in the chrome. Compatibility is the story; the driver is not.

nouns.use: A bench a person opens. Cites prims; may cite tools. Not a type. Not a third tool kind.
nouns.dont: Do not mint prim.applet. Not a separate product line.

nouns.use: A process written down is a prim. Pin id and hash. A connector walks it.
nouns.dont: Not a required field. Not one official process per type. Not a type called pipeline, factory, or forge.

nouns.use: Exploratory. Encrypted Prim as the vault file. Knox stays under the hood.
nouns.dont: Not a CHARTER lock. Do not mint a secrets type from the stub page.

nouns.use: Exploratory. Agent asks; you approve. Hancock stays under the hood.
nouns.dont: Not a CHARTER lock. Do not mint an approvals type from the stub page.

nouns.use: Lean only on the Desktop page. Prims Drive is the product; sync is a feature of that plane.
nouns.dont: Do not cement Drive-as-sync. Do not call Prims Drive 'Google Drive sync for Desktop.'

product_family.name: Prim
product_family.job: The primitive unit of knowledge and memory for AI. Voice, sayings, packaging, family.
do: Lead with the category line and the four sayings.
Keep theme paper and theme-color #f4f3ef.
dont: Rewrite the homepage into hype.
Put Eidos company doctrine on this page.

product_family.name: Prims Desktop
product_family.job: Personal Mac memory pack. Holds Prims, viewers, connectors, applets, and chat. Agents only see what you admit.
do: Cite prims.sh/desktop as the face.
Three doors only if you mention the chrome: Viewer, Connectors, Chat.
Mark Secrets / Approvals / Drive-as-sync as provisional.
dont: Never desktop.prims.sh.
Do not treat Viewer as a connector.
Do not put the AI harness in the chrome.

product_family.name: Prims Drive
product_family.job: Multi-org cloud drive for teams and agents. .prim packs live on the drive plane.
do: Call it a multi-org teams cloud drive.
Keep git, local, and legacy Drive under the hood.
dont: This is not Google Drive sync for Prim Desktop.
Do not crown one email as the mega-hub.

product_family.name: Prims Applets
product_family.job: Soft framing for compositions agents hit all the time: a password or an approval. Lives with Prims Desktop.
do: Treat Secrets and Approvals as applets, not a third product line.
Keep Knox and Hancock as engines under the hood.
dont: Do not mint types from this page.
Not a separate product. Not just a connector.

product_family.name: Prim Workbook
product_family.job: Living viewer. workbook-editor; the pack is authority.
do: Say the pack is authority.
Connectors on a workbook are Prim Tools, not pack types.
dont: Do not invent workbook chrome colors into this kit.
Do not treat the viewer as the store.

product_family.name: Prim viewers
product_family.job: A host frame. The pack stays the file.
do: Call it a surface and a host frame.
Drop a .prim; resize a real tool.
dont: Viewer is not a Desktop connector.

product_family.name: How it comes together
product_family.job: A Prim is the file. A tool hits it. An applet is the bench. A process is one house’s order of those hits.
do: Keep two category nouns: prims and tools.
Cite, don’t pour.
dont: Do not mint prim.applet.
Do not add a third tool kind.

product_family.name: prim.process
product_family.job: A process written down clearly enough to run is a process an agent can carry. The file is the argument.
do: Name the steps, the tool, and who publishes.
Judgment is located, not disqualified.
dont: Not a required field on every prim.
Not one official process per type.

product_family.name: Docs
product_family.job: The spec as a prim. This page is the vessel. The pack is the file.
do: Read / Face / History / Pack tabs stay views of one pack.
dont: Do not treat the HTML chrome as the specification.

product_family.name: Prim demo
product_family.job: Click through kinds. Each file becomes an editor.
do: The file is the store. The editor is a view.
dont: Do not import demo rail hexes (Linear-like blues) into this kit.

product_family.name: Registry
product_family.job: Type, tool, and applet registry. Live API face is registry.prims.sh.
do: Point product copy at https://registry.prims.sh/.
Types and tools are registry rows; applets are compositions.
dont: Do not treat prims.sh/registry/ as a second registry.
Do not mint Secrets or Approvals as registry types from a stub.

modes.ink: Dark specimen and OS dark. Gold folio on ink. Cream folio only as reverse on ink.
modes.system: Follows prefers-color-scheme. Same two fields; no third palette.

usage_rules: Never stretch, skew, or add drop shadows, gradients, or outlines.
Never use the Eidos tridot for Prim.
Never use desktop.prims.sh. The Desktop face is prims.sh/desktop.
Gold folio on ink. Ink folio on paper. Cream folio only as reverse on ink.
The mark is a bound file: spine plus page with a folded corner. Keep both parts.
Use logo.png on Drive, Applets, Workbook, Viewers, Together, Docs. Use logo-tight.png on Desktop chrome.
Do not cheer. Do not hype. Prim is infrastructure.
Do not copy Eidos house brass/cream doctrine into this pack.
Secrets, Approvals, and Drive-as-sync are provisional. Mark them. Do not cement.
If you mention Desktop chrome, three doors only: Viewer, Connectors, Chat. Viewer is a surface, not a connector.

files.note: Vendored from google/fonts ofl/instrumentsans (InstrumentSans[wdth,wght].ttf), renamed for a stable @font-face URL.

type_note: Prim prefers Instrument Sans + IBM Plex Mono on the web. Both are OFL and shipped in-pack. kit.css @font-face loads these files; do not substitute Space Grotesk or Inter unless this pack says so. Display headlines on prims.sh use weight 500, letter-spacing about -0.04em, era size clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.2rem). Kickers are IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, gold.

Consumer-app cheerfulness.
Eidos company doctrine or the house brass/cream story.

Store the concept. Generate the files.
sayings_also: The primitive unit of knowledge and memory for AI.

enterprise_love.name: Time capsules
enterprise_love.line: The work survives the person, the session, and the vendor. Open it in ten years. It’s still the Prim.

enterprise_love.name: Shareable
enterprise_love.line: One file. Desk to desk, agent to agent, counsel to the board. You send the prim — not a zip of conflicting sheets.

enterprise_love.name: Company property
enterprise_love.line: The knowledge is the firm’s. Not trapped in someone’s laptop, a chat log, or a tool that walks out the door.

ai_love.name: They can read it
ai_love.line: No scraping a deck. No guessing which tab is the source of truth. The file is native — agents reason over it without a translation layer.

ai_love.name: They can trust it
ai_love.line: Claims carry evidence, hashes, and provenance. Validation is fail-closed. An agent doesn’t have to hope the spreadsheet is right.

ai_love.name: They can continue it
ai_love.line: A session is a Prim. The next agent picks up the same file. Work doesn’t die when the window closes.
